Gross revenue, including other income, increased 6.3% YoY to INR 5,686 crore.
For H1FY27, consolidated gross revenue grew 5.7% YoY to INR 11,245 crore.
EBITDA remained flat YoY at INR 1,217 crore, with EBITDA margin moderating to 21.4% (vs 22.7% YoY), primarily reflecting higher power procurement, employee and operating expenses.
valuation: CESC accelerated its renewable expansion through Purvah Green, targeting 10 GW over the medium term.
